grub_timeout.description: Seconds before booting the default entry

grub_default.description: Default boot entry (e.g., 'saved', '0', or 'gnulinux-advanced-…' UUID-based identifier)

grub_distro.description: Distribution name for OS prober identification

grub_cmdline_linux.description: Kernel command line parameters for all Linux entries

grub_cmdline_linux_default.description: Additional kernel command line parameters for default entries

grub_terminal.description: Terminal output methods (e.g., 'console', 'serial', 'gfxterm'. GRUB 2 uses space-separated values like 'gfxterm console' in the config file, but often presented as a single string or joined list in higher-level tools. The standard /etc/default/grub format uses a quoted string like "gfxterm console".)

grub_background.description: Path to background image for GRUB menu

grub_save_default.description: Whether to save last-selected entry as default

grub_disable_os_prober.description: Disable automatic detection of other OSes (e.g., Windows)

grub_custom_entries.description: List of custom GRUB menu entries added via grub-customizer (not stored in /etc/default/grub, but reflected in grub.cfg via custom script hooks; included for completeness). Each entry has optional hidden/disabled flags.

grub_custom_entries.items.description: Custom menu entry (as parsed from /boot/grub/custom.cfg or custom script templates by grub-customizer). Not a direct /etc/default/grub setting but commonly managed via GUI and reflected in final config.

default_grub_customizer_enabled.description: Whether grub-customizer was used to manage this configuration

grub_disable_recovery.description: Disable generation of recovery mode entries in the boot menu. A key security/UX setting in modern GRUB 2 configs.
